propositions: The attest package requires full type annotation to pass mypy with --disallow-untyped-defs flag and join the typing ratchet, with authorship.py having 13 unannotated function signatures as the primary blocker.

Function signatures in authorship.py must be annotated with proper types (repo_root, callable parameters like resolve and is_ancestor, position_resolver) without introducing new explicit Any annotations beyond the two pre-existing trust_root boundary annotations in registry.py.

The annotation work must maintain exactly 2 explicit Any annotations (registry.py:62,89 on trust_root parameter) and must not modify pyproject.toml, keeping changes isolated to attest/*.py files with zero in-progress contention.
All annotations must be compatible with `from __future__ import annotations` and follow conventions already established in the package (e.g., str | None for optional parameters).
